title: No notification before a device is marked non-compliant

report.title: {Items.Count} compliance {Plural(Items.Count, 'policy marks', 'policies mark')} a device non-compliant without warning the user first

messages.businessImpact: The device is marked non-compliant with nothing said to the person using it. Where Conditional Access acts on compliance, the first they know is losing access to their mail or files, so a problem they could have fixed themselves becomes a service desk call.
remediation: Add a Send email to end user action ahead of the Mark device noncompliant one, with a message saying what to do about it.
messages.cannotSee: Whether the notification says anything useful is not read, only that one is scheduled. A policy that emails an empty template counts here as one that warns. Compliance authored in the Settings Catalog is not read: this tool reads the typed compliance API, so a policy authored there is invisible. Whether an unassigned policy is a draft or an oversight is also not visible, and the Assigned to column says which listed policies reach nobody.
